items.title: What Biodiversity Can Measure
items.summary: Biodiversity is a crucial measure of ecosystem health. By focusing on functional connectivity, we can quantify how species interact and contribute to ecosystem function. We can also see how increasing biodiversity enhances carbon removal by boosting ecosystem resilience and adaptability. This has implications for market-based biodiversity banks and registries and for how we intervene in ecosystems to achieve specific benefits.
